headline: A2R Holdings Discloses Substantial Acquisition in Prime Focus Limited Under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: A2R Holdings filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations with NSE, signalling a substantial share acquisition in Prime Focus Limited. The filing initiates formal takeover-regime scrutiny and triggers open-offer obligations if thresholds are breached.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are gating events under India's takeover regime: they lock in reporting obligations and start the 4-week open-offer clock if the acquirer crosses 25% or a promoter threshold, and failure to file or material misstatement exposes both acquirer and target to SEBI action and trading halts.
detail: A2R Holdings submitted its Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE, which requires acquirers crossing 5% thresholds (or persons acting in concert) to disclose shareholding, source of funds, and intent within 2 days of the triggering acquisition. The filing does not itself confirm the acquisition structure, valuation, or timeline, but marks the formal entry into SEBI's substantial acquisition gating regime. Prime Focus Limited, a digital media and technology services company, is thereby subject to open-offer obligations if A2R crosses applicable thresholds under Reg 31.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 5-7
framework.note: Open-offer obligation: triggered at 25% for ordinary acquisition or any increase by any acquirer holding >50%; 4-week timeline.
Regulator power to suspend trading and enforce takeover code; breach of takeover norms invokes suspension risk.
